visual_action: A static, meme-style video split into two panels, both showing Donald Trump speaking at a podium with American flags in the background. Text is superimposed over both panels, as well as at the very top of the screen.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Shown speaking in the video clips.

cast.name: Jeffrey Epstein
cast.evidence: The on-screen text states, 'Trump is now admitting his Epstein deflection tactics 😅'.

cast.name: Barack Obama
cast.evidence: The on-screen text attributes a quote to Trump: "just say, 'Obama cheated on the election.'"

on_screen_text.text: Trump is now admitting his Epstein deflection tactics 😅
Every time they give you a question that is not appropriate,
just say, 'Obama cheated on the election.'

spoken_summary: A male voice provides commentary over the video, saying, "He's lost, man. He don't know what the f*ck to do."
audio_music: A derogatory commentary track with a male voice plays over the entire clip. The fingerprinted music is identified as 'He Lost' by TrueToneFret. The effect is mocking.
editing_pacing: Static meme-style presentation using two still or near-still clips of Trump arranged in panels with text overlays.
manipulation_or_satire: The video superimposes text onto clips of Donald Trump speaking, falsely attributing a quote to him. The quote, 'Every time they give you a question that is not appropriate, just say, ‘Obama cheated on the election,’' is presented as something he said, but the actual audio is a commentary track, not Trump's voice. This fabricates a confession from Trump about his 'deflection tactics'.
central_claim: Donald Trump has confessed to using a fabricated claim about Barack Obama cheating in an election as a tactic to deflect from questions about his relationship with Jeffrey Epstein.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as a foolish and transparently manipulative person and to mock him for his supposed strategies for avoiding difficult questions.
